propositions: Three defensive exception handlers in gate_dispatch and container_stage that decide LLM-tier failure abort versus degrade behavior have no test coverage reaching them
Plan-review and code-review mid-run arms in gate_dispatch catch both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError but only LLMUnavailableError is tested, leaving the input-rejected path untested
Container warm-call abort in container_stage._run_container raises on systemic LLM errors but its abort-versus-degrade logic is untested with zero referencing tests in the module
Batch-runner exception propagation pathway is reachable in production through ProductionBatchRunner.run_pass1 and container warm-call abort, making these defensive arms live code not dead code
Mutation testing confirms each untested arm is logically necessary: reverting to pre-43d4 form or narrowing exception types causes test failures
